extraction.document_summary: This brochure describes two Singlife government-approved CareShield Life/ElderShield “supplement” plans: Singlife CareShield Standard and Singlife CareShield Plus. Both pay an additional monthly benefit on top of the national CareShield Life/ElderShield severe disability payout when the Life Assured meets the plans’ severe disability definition (based on inability to perform Activities of Daily Living (ADLs)). Singlife CareShield Standard requires inability to perform at least three ADLs, while CareShield Plus requires inability to perform at least two ADLs. The brochure also adds benefits beyond the base severe disability monthly payout: a monthly Add-on benefit for up to 12 months (with earlier ADL triggers for Plus vs Standard), Dependant Care Benefit up to 36 months, Caregiver Relief Benefit up to 12 months, and lump-sum payouts (including a death lump sum that is three times the last monthly benefit). Payment mode flexibility includes limited premium payment options and MediSave usage (up to S$600 per calendar year). A key caveat is the 90-day deferment period before specified benefits are paid.
quality_notes: Document clearly differentiates Singlife CareShield Standard vs Singlife CareShield Plus and states their ADL-based severe disability triggers.

Exact dollar amounts are given as ranges for the additional monthly benefit (S$200 to S$5,000 more each month), but other benefit components (e.g., exact percentages) are given in “Important notes” rather than a table; these were still extracted as written.
Entry age, maximum coverage age, and exact premium amounts/limits are not stated in the brochure.
No explicit exclusions section is provided; only procedural caveats (e.g., deferment period, MediSave limit) are stated.

policies.quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement paying an additional monthly benefit for severe disability when you can’t perform at least 3 ADLs. Offers a monthly Add-on benefit (for moderate to severe disabilities) and further Dependant Care/Caregiver Relief benefits, plus lump-sum benefits including a 3x death payout. Includes MediSave premium payment (up to S$600/year) and a 90-day deferment period before specified benefits start, with waiver of premium after the deferment period. Additional monthly payouts may be fixed or increasing, and the brochure states the additional monthly benefit is S$200 to S$5,000 more each month on top of the government plan.
coverage_scope: Severe disability (ADL-based) additional monthly payout (on top of CareShield Life/ElderShield)
Add-on benefit for moderate to severe disability (ADL trigger)
Lump Sum Benefit for severe disability and death lump sum payout
Waiver of Premium relief (mild disability trigger)
policies.eligibility_notes: You need to have a CareShield Life (CSHL) or ElderShield (ESH) policy before you purchase Singlife CareShield Standard.
policies.coverage_term_description: You are entitled to the monthly additional payout for as long as you’re severely disabled.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Choose a premium payment period: (i) Pay up to the policy anniversary after you turn 98, or (ii) pay for a limited time (with later of two stated options applying).
important_caveats: 90-day Deferment Period applies for selected benefits: monthly benefit, Lump Sum Benefit, Dependant Care Benefit and Caregiver Relief Benefit are paid after the Deferment Period.
Severe disability definitions differ by product: Standard requires inability to perform at least three ADLs.
MediSave premium payment is applicable up to S$600 per calendar year, per life assured; premiums exceeding this limit will have to be paid in cash.

evidence.quote: Get S$200 to S$5,000 more each month, on top of the basic severe disability payout from your government plan. You’re entitled to this payout for as long as you’re severely disabled¹.
Choose between fixed or increasing payouts – consistent with your payouts make budgeting easier, while those that grow (by 2% or 3% annually) can help you to manage inflation.

Important notes
1. Severe disability refers to being unable to perform at least two (for Singlife CareShield Plus) or three (for Singlife CareShield Standard) of the six Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).

The Deferment Period is a period of 90 days from the date the Life Assured is confirmed and certified by an Appointed Assessor as being severely disabled.
The monthly benefit, Lump Sum Benefit, Dependant Care Benefit and Caregiver Relief Benefit will be paid after the Deferment Period.

Offers a monthly Add-on benefit for moderate-to-severe disability triggered by inability to perform at least 1 ADL, plus Dependant Care (up to 36 months) and Caregiver Relief (up to 12 months) components and lump-sum payouts. MediSave premium payment is possible up to S$600/year, and a 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits with waiver of premium after the deferment period.
